# V1 catalogue comparison

Compared 5184 distinct legacy IDs with 7140 candidate listings. 2714 added, 4443 changed or merged, 741 dropped.

- Compared with the library snapshot and community feed at agent-catalog. R1 source checks supplied the original drop and merge reasons.
- V1 reviewed classification and evidence add 32 drops. The detailed V1-stage reconciliation follows below.
- Published statuses: ok 6967, profile 43, brochure 128, adult 2.
- Topic coverage: 7133 of 7140 listings, using 332 of 332 topic codes.
- Classified 20,987 tools: 13,790 read, 6,465 write, 732 risky. 2156 listings reference 2133 distinct blobs.

| bundle | 315 | 0 | 310 |
| mcp/http | 4136 | 4089 | 5766 |
| mcp/npm | 529 | 525 | 508 |
| mcp/pypi | 129 | 126 | 155 |
| mcp/sse | 56 | 26 | 0 |
| skill | 19 | 0 | 401 |
